profile.title: Profile
profile.photoDesc: Shown in the sidebar and across the app.
profile.name: Your name
profile.nameDesc: How you appear in the workspace.
profile.signOutDesc: Sign out of feega on this device.
profile.cookieHint: Choose which analytics and marketing cookies feega may use.
profile.exportHint: A JSON file with your profile, workspaces, projects, messages you wrote and the credit history of workspaces you own.
profile.deleteHint: Deletes your login, profile, API keys and chats you started. Workspaces where you are the only member are deleted with their files, and their plan is cancelled at period end. Workspaces shared with others keep their work. This cannot be undone.
profile.deleteConfirmLabel: Type DELETE or your email to confirm
profile.deleteConfirmError: Type DELETE or your email exactly.
profile.deleteReauth: For safety, sign in again (within the last 15 minutes) and retry.
profile.deleteTransfer: You are the only owner of a workspace with other members. Make someone else owner, or remove the members, first.

dashboard.cloud: Feega Cloud is coming. For now, Feega lives in your editor.

cookie.title: Cookies on feega
cookie.text: We use strictly necessary cookies to sign you in and keep feega secure. With your consent we also use analytics to improve the product and marketing tags to measure our ads.
cookie.necessaryHint: Sign-in, session and security. Always on.
cookie.analyticsHint: PostHog, Microsoft Clarity, Seline, error replays.
cookie.marketingHint: Meta Pixel and the Google gtag.js conversion tag.

notFound.title: This page doesn't exist
notFound.body: The link is wrong, or the page has moved. Everything you've made is still where you left it.

denied.title: This page isn't accessible
denied.body: It belongs to another account, or your session has expired.

generic.title: Something broke on our side
generic.body: The page didn't load. Try again in a moment; if it keeps failing, write to us.
